description: NHC working best track of Hurricane Melissa (AL132025) as 12 line segments, each carrying the storm type and Saffir-Simpson category (SS) along that stretch of the track. No time column: NHC's line file carries none; use best-track/points for times and intensities.

links.title: Working best track line by intensity segment

table:columns.name: STORMNUM
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): sequential number of the cyclone in the basin (13).

table:columns.name: STORMTYPE
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): storm type along the segment: TS (1 segment), HU (11).

table:columns.name: SS
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): Saffir-Simpson category along the segment: 0 (1 segment), 1 (4), 2 (3), 3 (2), 4 (1), 5 (1).

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Track segment (LineString, all valid) in lon/lat WGS 84 (typed OGC:CRS84 in the hosted file); extent -78.6, 14.0, -51.3, 46.6.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin DOUBLE, ymin DOUBLE, xmax DOUBLE, ymax DOUBLE)
table:columns.description: GeoParquet bounding-box covering column (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) written for predicate pushdown; not an NHC attribute.
